Animate this ONE distinct action: Look around with lively curiosity: a quick glance to screen left, briefly down near the boots, then up to screen right, followed by a small alert look over the opposite shoulder. Vary the timing with short curious pauses; head leads and shoulders subtly follow. Keep both boots planted. Finish by looking back at the viewer in the original pose. This is only a scanning-around gesture, no hood adjustment.

Preserve the exact supplied Ink shadow creature: oversized charcoal fabric hood, layered dark jacket, black gloves and boots, chibi proportions, smooth black shadow face, two warm ivory slanted painted eyes with small white paint drips. Eyes can blink, widen and narrow expressively while preserving their identity; no mouth, nose or robot features. Personality: secretive, curious, cheeky and very alive. Use clear anticipation, brief asymmetric pauses, expressive head and shoulder motion and natural clothing follow-through, with smooth settling after crisp gestures. No new props, ink effects, smoke or liquid transformations.
Only the character moves. Perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00FF00 digital background and invisible floor remain unchanged, including actual gaps between limbs. Neutral white subject lighting independent of the plate, no green reflections, fringe, rim light, glow, gradients or cast background shadows. Opaque clothes and eyes remain opaque; crisp antialiased silhouette without motion blur.
Locked full-body camera, scale, exposure and white balance. Keep the ENTIRE character, all fingers, boots and the complete movement envelope fully inside EVERY frame with generous empty margins. No zoom, camera movement, approach toward camera, cropping or scene changes.
One seamless eight-second loop. Start and finish in the exact supplied neutral pose, original position, scale, eye shape and lighting. Return through real physical motion and smoothly settle to matching velocity at the seam; no cuts, dissolve or reverse playback. Silent.
